note: The spawned Goblin deals direct melee damage. Zero disables a traveling attack projectile; it must not inherit the barrel transport speed. GoblinBarrelSpell.spawnCharacterData has damage and melee range with no projectileData. https://cache.statsroyale.com/gamedata-v5.json
Decoy Goblins also deal direct melee damage. GoblinBarrelSpell_EV1_Decoy.spawnCharacterData has no projectileData. https://cache.statsroyale.com/gamedata-v5.json
Spawned Skeletons have melee damage and no projectileData; they must not inherit the Witch's ranged attack. https://cache.statsroyale.com/gamedata-v5.json

Cursed Hogs use a direct melee attack against buildings, not the Mother Witch's projectile. Zero selects direct damage rather than an estimated projectile speed. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Mother_Witch
Guardienne's ordinary sword attack is melee; it must not inherit the Little Prince's crossbow projectile. Her charge remains a separate ability. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Little_Prince
